name: Kounotori 6 gouki
about: Kounotori 6 gouki (2016-076A), a crewed vehicle (HTV), launched 2016 Dec  9. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2016 Dec 10), held fixed
docked to A06499; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
GCAT gives the end of mission (psatcat TDate) without an hour

events.why: GCAT gives the end of mission without an hour
